about: Which workspaces the switcher offers and which one opens. Workspaces are joined spaces; a top-level one is a child of no joined space. entries lists the top-level workspaces in name order, then All (null) only while some joined channel belongs to no workspace; direct messages and invitations never count. choose opens the remembered workspace while it is still known (any joined space, nested ones too), or All while the switcher offers it; else the workspace of the conversation on screen; else the top-level workspace with the most joined channels, the first by name on a tie, so a first launch lands where the person works. "__all__" is how a remembered choice of All is stored.
